# cortex-ia

cortex-ia compiles and safely installs evidence-backed workflow assets for four coding-agent targets.

- ForgeSpec: authoritative contracts, task DAG/readiness/claim/status, qualified file reservations.
- Cortex: durable evidence, provenance, memory, and relationships.
- Runtime-native dispatch: direct bounded child transport only.
- Profiles: `portable-sequential`, `portable-flat`, and qualified `native-advanced`.
- ForgeSpec modes: capability-qualified `direct-v1` or visible `legacy-sequential`.
- Provider-neutral remote A2A: unsupported and unbound.

The historical Agent Mailbox built-in and `team-lead` role are retired. External Mailbox data and repositories are never automatically mutated or deleted; cleanup is operator-controlled.
